title: Grilled Tuna Skewers
description: A Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring grilled tuna, served with a hint of Egyptian spices.

ingredients.name: egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, Egyptian spices, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the tuna steaks.
Thread the tuna, onions, and any other desired vegetables onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tuna reaches 145°F internal temperature.
Remove from heat and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
